Question Choices: A matrix has 2 rows and 5 columns. What are its dimensions?
Solution: An m by n matrix has m rows, n columns and mn entries. Entry a_ij is in row i and column j; row number comes first. Its dimensions are 2 by 5.

Question Choices: How many entries does a 3x4 matrix have?
Solution: An m by n matrix has m rows, n columns and mn entries. Entry a_ij is in row i and column j; row number comes first. Three rows times four columns gives 12 entries.

Question Choices: Add the matrices [[1, 0], [2, 1]] and [[3, 4], [5, 6]]. Enter the second row.
Solution: Matrix addition and subtraction require identical dimensions and act entry by entry. Scalar multiplication multiplies every entry. These operations retain the dimensions; addition is commutative because scalar addition is commutative. Second row=(2+5,1+6)=(7,7).
